name: Uniao Pet Participacoes S.A.
summary: Uniao Pet Participacoes S.A. engages in the retail sale of articles and food for pets and animals in Brazil. It sells its products under the Spet and Pet Anjo brands through stores and online commerce. The company also provides intermediary services related to animal care through the Pet Anjo brand. Uniao Pet Participacoes S.A. was formerly known as Cobasi Comércio de Produtos Básicos e Industrializados S.A. and changed its name to Uniao Pet Participacoes S.A. in January 2026. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil.
